# Launch screen assets

This image set supplies the iOS launch-screen artwork.

Replace the existing scale variants while preserving the names referenced in `Contents.json`. On macOS, open `ios/Runner.xcworkspace` in Xcode and select the Runner asset catalogue to review the image set.

Keep the launch artwork aligned with the application's branding and review the resulting appearance on the intended device sizes. General project setup is described in the [build guide](../../../../docs/BUILD_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md).
